description: Extend a backtest engine to support synchronized multi-asset replay for BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, then implement a BTC/ETH ratio mean-reversion strategy with per-asset accounting.
agent_prompt: You are given two daily-bar CSVs at /workspace/data/BTCUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv and /workspace/data/ETHUSDT_1d_2021_2024.csv. Build a backtest engine in /workspace/src/ that (1) loads and time-aligns both series, (2) replays synchronized bar tuples each step, (3) computes a BTC/ETH ratio signal and trades a mean-reversion rule, and (4) tracks positions and PnL separately per asset. Run the backtest end-to-end and write outputs to /workspace/output/: per_asset_metrics.json (keys: BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT — each with total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown), portfolio_metrics.json (combined total_return, sharpe, max_drawdown), and equity_curve.csv. The reference docs in /workspace/docs/ describe accepted accounting conventions.

required_capabilities: Load and time-align multiple asset data series
Build a synchronized multi-asset replay mechanism
Track positions and PnL separately per asset
Implement a ratio-based mean-reversion strategy that operates on synchronized data
Produce per-asset and portfolio-level performance metrics
